mil3.1.12:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of energy?”
mil3.1.12:1.3: “Energy, Great King, has the characteristic of propping up; all skillful qualities propped up by energy do not decline.”
mil3.1.12:2.2: “Just as, Great King, when a house is falling down, a man might prop it up with another timber, and being propped up, that house would not fall down;
mil3.1.12:2.3: so too, Great King, energy has the characteristic of propping up; all skillful qualities propped up by energy do not decline.”
mil3.1.12:3.2: “Just as, Great King, if a great army were breaking a small army, then the king would have them encourage one another, send reinforcements, and add further strength to his own small army, and with that the small army would break the great army;
mil3.1.12:3.3: so too, Great King, energy has the characteristic of propping up; all skillful qualities propped up by energy do not decline.
mil3.1.12:3.5: ‘A noble disciple who is energetic, mendicants, gives up what is unskillful and develops what is skillful.
